clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature or discard a creature card.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'ask may: [fire, skip]'; skip -> nothing happens; fire -> 'ask choose: [0, 1]'; 0 -> 'ask one_of: [you_bear, you_giant, card]' (only my creatures, itself included) and the pick is sacrificed (you_bear, you_giant, or the Lurker itself); 1 -> 'ask one_of: [you_spare, you_cast_creature]' (creature cards in hand only, the instant excluded) and the pick moves hand -> graveyard. Also triggers when it enters on the opponent's turn.

clauses.clause: If you do, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Every fire variant that sacrificed or discarded draws exactly one card (you:Library 5#1 to hand); skip draws nothing. Pack P9d5b1baa20_crypt_lurker_nothing_to_discard.json PASSES: picking 'discard' with no creature card in hand discards nothing and draws nothing.
